The top-level payload also gains `n_judge_calls: <N>`. Downstream code that reads `row["score"]` will work in both modes (integer / float coerce); but any consumer that strictly checks `isinstance(row["score"], int)` would break. There are no such consumers in the cherry-picked code (`i498_phase5_analyze.py` reads `score` as a numeric); flagging anyway.
